{{Quote|You done?|Guard to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] enlisted member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed at [[Mulvar Sensor Station]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''Although [[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]], the novel contains numerous flashbacks set in earlier years, including [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the enlisted man was on duty at the summit of Tower Three, monitoring a bank of infrared-equipped [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] monitors, when [[Voort saBinring]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], disguised as a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] maintenance worker, arrived to clean a fungal stain from the station's perimeter wall. The guard allowed saBinring onto the wall by disabling the [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and their sensor triggers. After saBinring completed his work and returned to the tower, he [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the guard with a compact [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to start the Wraith's [[Raid on Mulvar sensor station|operation]] of destroying the station.<ref name="MK" />
